limitations: Adaptive development experiment; selecting among30 evaluated checkpoints on2 common poses can overfit.
Original arms have3 optimizer seeds each; ablations have2 each. Compare ablations with matched original PPO seeds11/23 separately.
Repeated optimizer outcomes reuse the same poses, not independent physical starts.
selection: Unchanged frozen rule: no faults and both upright development poses balanced throughout; rank hanging final-five-second holds, earlier mean first1s capture among held episodes, then mean longest hanging dwell. Initial checkpoint remains eligible.
tie_break: Stable listed run order, then listed checkpoint evaluation order. Original six runs first in prior order; four ablations appended. Duplicate initial actor weights remain one baseline control, not independent initialization evidence.
